text:
ITEM 1 | Three golden-brown breaded fillets, flaky-looking coating with light tan and darker browned edges, moist-looking pale interior at one cut end; two sit at the top-left and center, one lower-left, each roughly 7 x 4 cm and about 2 cm thick, lying on greens | 260
ITEM 2 | Roasted carrot pieces, bright orange with caramelized darker edges and slight glossy sheen, cut into rounds and chunks about 2-4 cm, scattered across the right half of the plate | 150
ITEM 3 | Roasted yellow and golden root vegetable pieces, some with dark charred spots, small wedges about 2-3 cm, mixed among the carrots on the right | 60
ITEM 4 | Dark purple-black roasted vegetable pieces with slightly wrinkled charred skin, small irregular chunks about 2 cm, clustered near the center-right between carrots | 40
ITEM 5 | Thin sliced reddish-brown roasted sausage-like pieces, glossy with browned edges, about 1 cm thick and 3 cm long, one cluster near the lower center | 30
ITEM 6 | Small bright green leafy greens, finely torn, some wilted, sitting in small amounts under the fillets and between vegetables at the center | 15
ITEM 7 | Light brown crumbs and small bits of breading scattered on the plate surface near the fillets, dry and crumbly | 3
